item.title: Han Sung-sook "Deeply Apologizes for Personal Data Leak in 'Everyone's Startup'" (한성숙 “모두의창업 개인정보 유출, 진심으로 사과”)
item.description:
<<>> On the 22nd, Prime Minister nominee Han Sung-sook issued an apology regarding a data breach incident in which personal information and business ideas of thousands of participants in the startup support program 'Everyone's Startup,' led by the Ministry of SMEs and Startups, were leaked. She stated, "I sincerely apologize to the users who have experienced concern and inconvenience due to the personal information leak on the Everyone's Startup platform." <<> Han arrived at the office of the Prime Minister nominee confirmation hearing preparation team, set up at the Financial Supervisory Training Institute in Tongui-dong, Jongno-gu, Seoul, that morning and said, "As the minister in charge, I feel a heavy sense of responsibility and offer my deepest apologies." She added, "The Ministry of SMEs and Startups immediately implemented emergency security measures, such as blocking initial external access upon recognizing the incident, and is investigating the cause and details of the leak with relevant authorities." She emphasized, "To ensure objectivity and expertise in the security inspection, we will proceed simultaneously with professional agencies for security diagnostics and the development of improvement measures." <<> Han stated, "Above all, we will prioritize protecting affected users and swiftly implement necessary measures to prevent further damage, while also preparing measures to ensure that challengers' ideas are safely protected." She also promised, "We will conduct a full review of personal data protection and security management systems, strengthen supervision of external contractors and checks on security vulnerabilities to prevent recurrence of similar cases," and "We will transparently disclose investigation results to the public and take strict measures regarding faults and responsibilities." She added, "I will also meet with the participants of Everyone's Startup in person going forward." <<> The Korea Institute of Startup & Entrepreneurship Development, under the Ministry of SMEs and Startups, apologized on the 18th through a notice on its website, stating, "Recently, evidence of information leakage through unauthorized channels has been confirmed." The personal data leak affected approximately 5,000 first-round successful applicants. It was confirmed that information such as email addresses and evaluations of startup ideas had been leaked. <<> Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr ()

item.title: Cho Hyun-wook, Chair of the Fact-Finding Committee: “Unable to Obtain Minutes of Meeting on Reducing Ballot Paper Printing Due to Non-Disclosure Policy” (조현욱 진상규명위원장 “투표용지 인쇄축소 회의록, 비공개라 받지 못해”)
item.description:
Cho Hyun-wook, chair of the fact-finding committee investigating the ballot paper shortage during the June 3 local elections, stated on the 22nd that the National Election Commission (NEC) refused to submit the minutes of the meeting where the decision to reduce ballot paper printing was made, citing a ‘non-disclosure policy.’ (중앙선거관리위원회가 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 인쇄 축소 지침이 결정된 회의록을 ‘비공개 방침’이란 이유로 중앙선관위 투표용지 부족 사태 진상규명위원회에 제출하지 않았다고 조현욱 투표용지 부족 사태 진상규명위원장이 22일 밝혔다.)

Appearing on MBC Radio’s “Kim Jong-bae’s Focus,” Chair Cho said, “We wanted to see the minutes of the committee meeting that decided to reduce ballot paper printing, but the NEC said the minutes are confidential. We only received a summary of the resolutions and the agenda items proposed, but not the actual minutes themselves.” (조 위원장은 이날 문화방송(MBC) 라디오 ‘김종배의 시선집중’에 출연해 “투표용지 인쇄축소를 결정한 위원회 회의록을 공개해 저희가 보고 싶었는데 선관위 회의록은 비공개라고 해서 의결된 요지나 의안 상정한 것만 나왔고 그 회의록 자체는 받지 못했다”고 했다.)

Cho added, “Although we haven’t seen the minutes themselves, there was a process where frontline NEC staff raised various opinions—that printing more ballots would require extensive inspection, storage, and disposal procedures, which incur costs and procedural issues, and that leftover ballots could raise suspicions of election fraud. So a task force (TF) was formed to propose reducing the number.” (이어 조 위원장은 “회의록 자체는 저희가 못 봤지만 일선에서 선관위 직원들이 여러 가지 의견을 올릴 때 많이 인쇄를 하면 일일이 다 검수해야 되고, 보관해야 되고, 또 폐기하는 데도 절차상 비용상 문제가 있고, 또 남으면 ‘왜 이거를 많이 했냐. 부정선거 의혹도 있다’ 이런 의견들이 올라와서 티에프(TF)팀을 만들어서 줄이자는 그런 과정은 있었다”고 덧붙였다.)

In response, an NEC official stated, “If the minutes are disclosed, it could hinder the fair execution of duties by undermining the individual opinions of NEC members, who must maintain political neutrality. Therefore, non-disclosure is the principle. However, if requested by a special committee on parliamentary investigation, the minutes could be submitted.” (중앙선관위 관계자는 이에 대해 “회의록이 공개될 경우 정치적 중립을 지켜야 하는 중앙선관위원 개개인의 소신 발언이 저해되기 때문에 공정한 업무수행에 지장을 초래할 수 있어서 비공개를 원칙으로 하고 있다”며 “국정조사특위에서 요구하면 제출할 수 있다”고 했다.)

Reporter Ko Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr (고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Park Jie-won: "President Lee is the Number One Asset of the Democratic Party... If We Fight Among Ourselves, We Die" (박지원 “이 대통령, 민주당 재산목록 1호…우리끼리 싸우면 죽어”)
item.description:
Park Jie-won, a lawmaker of the Democratic Party of Korea, stated, "President Lee Jae-myung is the number one asset of the Democratic Party," and "United we survive, divided we die." This remark reflects his concern over the ongoing so-called 'Myung-cheong (Lee Jae-myung and Jeong Cheong-rae) conflict' within the Democratic Party. (박지원 더불어민주당 의원이 “이재명 대통령이 민주당 재산목록 1호”라며 “뭉치면 살고 싸우면 죽는다”고 말했다. 민주당 안에서 이른바 ‘명청(이재명·정청래) 갈등’이 이어지는 상황을 우려한 것이다.)

On the 21st, in a Facebook post, Rep. Park said, "A successful president who has been in power for a year is the number one asset of the Democratic Party," and "We must move away from past-oriented conflicts and return to a future-focused stance on the people's livelihood economy, settling the insurrection, and completing the three major reforms, getting back to the Democratic Party we were two to three months ago." He added, "That is why we should help President Lee have a golden time to work in the next two years without elections, and engage in future-oriented competition within the party so that the country, the Democratic Party, you, and I can all survive." <<> Rep. Park also remarked, "Do you want to go back to a world where the insurrection party, Yoon again, Park Geun-hye, and MB (Lee Myung-bak) are strutting about?" and added, "Those who speak of winning the 2028 general election and achieving regime change in 2030 to become president are full of bravado." <<> Rep. Park further stated, "If our Democratic Party only engages in past-oriented fights, rolling out the red carpet for them, does that mean we are okay with losing the general election and undergoing regime change, as they claim?" He added, "Or is it a delusion that we will win even if we fight? I simply cannot understand it." <<> Rep. Park, the oldest lawmaker in the 22nd National Assembly with a fifth term, emphasized, "If we get clapped for one year and fight for four years, what will our future be?" and "I have experienced it, and history proves it." <<> Rep. Park had previously publicly urged Jeong Cheong-rae, the leader of the Democratic Party, not to run in the next party convention. However, Rep. Jeong appears likely to seek re-election. <<> Song Kyung-hwa Reporter freehwa@hani.co.kr (박 의원은 21일 페이스북에서 “집권 1년 된 성공한 대통령이 민주당의 재산목록 1호”라며 “과거형 전쟁이 아니라 미래형 민생경제, 내란청산, 3대 개혁 완수로 2~3개월 전의 민주당으로 돌아가야 한다”고 말했다. 이어 “그래서 이 대통령이 선거 없는 향후 2년간 일하는 골든타임이 되도록 돕고 당내에서도 미래형 경쟁을 해야 나라도 민주당도 당신도 저도 산다”고 했다.)

item.title: Han Dong-hoon's First Words After Victory: "I Nearly Died"… Pro-Han Lawmaker Woo Jae-jun: "I Haven't Visited Jang Dong-hyuk in the Hospital" (한동훈 당선 첫마디 “죽을 뻔”…친한 우재준 “장동혁 병문안 안 가”)
item.description:
Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon reportedly said to those around him shortly after winning the June 3 by-election for the National Assembly seat in Busan's Buk-gu District, "I nearly died." (한동훈 무소속 의원이 6·3 지방선거 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거 당선 직후 주변에 “죽을 뻔했다”고 말한 것으로 전해졌다.)

Woo Jae-jun, a lawmaker from the People Power Party (PPP) considered part of the pro-Han Dong-hoon faction, appeared on YTN Radio's "Jang Seong-cheol's News Meeting" on the 22nd and shared Han's first words after his victory. When asked what Han said first after winning, Woo replied, "I don't remember exactly when we met, but after his victory, he called me, and his first words were, 'I nearly died.'" The vote tally showed that Han (35,056 votes) and Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo (33,664 votes) were separated by only 1,392 votes. (친한동훈계로 꼽히는 우재준 국민의힘 의원은 22일 와이티엔(YTN) 라디오 ‘장성철의 뉴스명당’에 나와 ‘한 의원 당선 뒤 첫마디가 뭐였나’는 질문에 “만났을 때 첫마디는 제가 기억이 잘 나지 않는데, 당선되고 나서 저한테 전화가 한번 오셨는데 그때 첫마디는 ‘죽을 뻔했다’(였다)”고 전했다. 개표 결과 한 의원(3만5056표)과 하정우 더불어민주당 후보(3만3664표)의 표 차이는 불과 1392표였다.)

Regarding the timing of Han's return to the PPP, Woo said, "From Han's perspective, there's no major issue with taking his time to rejoin," adding, "He already has a two-year term guaranteed." However, he noted, "If we keep Han outside the party, it could be seen as neglecting the party's duties. On the issue of Han's expulsion being wrong, I believe the judgment of the public, especially Busan residents, has already been made." He added, "Considering that, I hope this matter (Han's reinstatement) isn't dragged out too long." (우 의원은 한 의원의 국민의힘 복당 시점에 관해서는 “한 의원 입장에서는 천천히 들어오는 게 큰 문제가 없다고 생각한다”며 “이미 2년이라는 임기가 보장돼 있으니까”라고 말했다. 다만 “한 의원을 계속해서 (국민의힘) 밖에 둘 것인가라고 했을 때는 당의 의무를 방기하는 측면도 있고 ‘한 의원 제명은 잘못됐다’는 부분에 있어 국민들, 특히 부산 시민들의 판단이 이미 끝났다고 생각한다”며 “그런 점을 고려하면 이것(한 의원 복당)을 너무 오래 끌지 않았으면 좋겠다”고 덧붙였다.)

Separately, when asked if he had visited PPP leader Jang Dong-hyuk, who is currently hospitalized in Seoul, Woo replied, "I haven't gone." When the host asked, "Why, don't you want to see him?" Woo responded, "It's not that. Rather, I may have caused him stress, and I'm concerned, but I thought visiting might stress him out even more." (한편, 우 의원은 최근 서울 시내 한 병원에 입원한 장동혁 국민의힘 대표 병문안을 갔느냐는 질문에 “가지 않았다”고 답했다. 진행자가 “왜요, 보기 싫어요?”라고 묻자 우 의원은 “그렇지는 않다. 오히려 제가 더 스트레스 드린 것도 있고 한데, 걱정은 되지만 오히려 제가 찾아가면 더 스트레스가 될까 봐”라고 답했다.)

Earlier, on the 11th, Woo had publicly called for the resignation of Jang's entire leadership during a party Supreme Council meeting. As the PPP's youth supreme council member, Woo said at the time, "I wish we (the leadership) would all step down." He added, "I know many party members like leader Jang. If so, it would be better to hold a new national convention, let (him) run again in a new election, and receive a fresh evaluation." In response, Cho Kwang-han, a senior supreme council member and close associate of Jang, publicly criticized Woo, saying, "Making childish remarks in public seems politically very immature." (앞서 우 의원은 지난 11일 장 대표 면전에서 장동혁 지도부 총사퇴를 주장한 바 있다. 국민의힘 청년최고위원인 우 의원은 당시 국회에서 열린 당 최고위원회의에서 “우리(지도부) 모두 사퇴했으면 좋겠다”고 말했다. 이어 “장 대표를 좋아하는 당원들이 많다는 걸 알고 있다. 그렇다면 차라리 다시 우리가 전당대회를 열어서 재선거를 통해서 다시 출마해서 다시 평가를 받으셔야 된다”고 했다. 그러자 장 대표의 최측근인 조광한 최고위원은 공개 발언에서 “철없는 소리를 공개적으로 하는 건 정치적으로 굉장히 미숙한 것 같다”며 우 의원을 저격했다.)

Reporter Jeon Gwang-jun light@hani.co.kr (전광준 기자 light@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic Party: "Han Chan-sik as Senior Presidential Secretary for Civil Affairs is the Right Person to Complete Prosecution Reform" (민주당 “한찬식 민정수석, 검찰개혁 완수할 적임자”)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea on the 22nd described Han Chan-sik, the newly appointed Senior Presidential Secretary for Civil Affairs at the Cheong Wa Dae, as "the right person to complete prosecution reform." (더불어민주당은 한찬식 청와대 신임 민정수석에 대해 22일 “검찰개혁을 완수할 적임자”라고 평했다.)

Democratic Party Senior Spokesperson Kang Joon-hyun met with reporters after the Supreme Council meeting at the National Assembly on the same day and said, "Senior Secretary Han served in the prosecution for 17 years and knows the prosecution better than anyone," adding, "Based on his expertise, he is the right person to complete the prosecution reform that the public desires." Spokesperson Kang also said, "(Senior Secretary Han) served as the head of the Ministry of Justice's Human Rights Bureau and in the prosecution leadership, and is a person who has accumulated strict law enforcement and human rights sensitivity," adding, "I believe this is an appointment that well embodies President Lee Jae-myung's line and will for judicial reform and pragmatism." <<> Senior Secretary Han, who has been tasked with coordinating the direction of amendments to the Criminal Procedure Act related to supplementary investigation rights, served as the chief prosecutor of the Seoul Eastern District Prosecutors' Office from 2018 to 2019, leading investigations such as the Moon Jae-in government's 'Ministry of Environment blacklist' probe. He left the prosecution in July 2019 when former President Yoon Suk-yeol, his junior at the Judicial Research and Training Institute, was appointed as the Prosecutor General. The previous day, the Rebuilding Korea Party issued a commentary on Senior Secretary Han, stating, "In the situation where discussions on the second phase of immediate prosecution reform are approaching in the latter half of this year, concerns have been raised about Senior Secretary Han's anti-reform record." <<> Reporter Choi Ha-yan chy@hani.co.kr Reporter Ko Kyung-joo goh@hani.co.kr (강준현 민주당 수석대변인은 이날 국회에서 열린 최고위원회의 뒤 기자들을 만나 “한 수석은 17년 동안 검찰에 재직하며 누구보다 검찰을 잘 아는 인물”이라며 “전문성을 바탕으로 국민이 바라는 검찰개혁을 완수할 적임자”라고 말했다. 강 대변인은 “(한 수석은) 법무부 인권국장과 검찰 지휘부를 역임했고 법 집행 엄정성과 인권 감수성이 축적된 인물”이라며 “사법개혁과 실용이라는 이재명 대통령의 노선과 의지를 잘 구현할 인선이라고 생각한다”고도 했다.)

item.title: President Lee's approval rating sees first dead cross: negative 49.7%, positive 46.7% [Realmeter] (이 대통령 지지율 첫 데드크로스…부정 49.7%-긍정 46.7% [리얼미터])
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung's job approval ratings recorded a 'dead cross' for the first time since his inauguration, with negative evaluations surpassing positive ones. The presidential office issued a statement on the 22nd, saying, "We accept this seriously and humbly, and we will examine more closely what the people are worried about and what they hope for." (이재명 대통령의 국정 수행 지지율이 취임 뒤 처음으로 부정평가가 긍정평가를 앞서는 ‘데드크로스’를 기록했다. 청와대는 22일 입장을 내고 “이를 엄중하고 겸허하게 받아들이며 국민께서 무엇을 걱정하고 무엇을 바라고 계신지 더욱 세심하게 살피겠다”고 했다.)

According to a survey conducted by Realmeter commissioned by Energy Economy News from the 15th to the 19th, targeting 2,517 voters aged 18 and older nationwide via wireless (100%) automated response (with a sampling error of ±2 percentage points at a 95% confidence level), positive evaluations of President Lee's job performance dropped by 4.8 percentage points from the previous week to 46.7%. Negative evaluations rose by 5.5 percentage points from the previous week to 49.7%. 'Don't know' responses were at 3.6%. Although the result is within the margin of error, negative evaluations outpacing positive ones is a first since his inauguration. This is also the first time President Lee's job approval rating has fallen into the 40% range based on Realmeter's survey. (리얼미터가 에너지경제신문 의뢰로 지난 15∼19일 전국 18살 이상 유권자 2517명을 대상으로 실시한 무선(100%) 자동응답 방식의 조사(표본오차 95% 신뢰 수준에 ±2%포인트)를 보면, 이 대통령 국정 수행에 대한 긍정평가는 전주보다 4.8%포인트 하락한 46.7%를 기록했다. 부정평가는 전주 대비 5.5%포인트 상승한 49.7%로 나타났다. ‘잘 모름’은 3.6%로 조사됐다. 오차범위 내 결과이긴 하지만 부정평가가 긍정평가를 앞선 것은 취임 후 처음이다. 리얼미터 조사 기준으로 이 대통령의 국정 수행 지지율이 40%대로 내려온 것도 처음이다.)

By region, Daegu and North Gyeongsang Province dropped by 9.9 percentage points from the previous week to 34.6%. Incheon and Gyeonggi Province fell by 7.6 percentage points to 44.8%, while Seoul dropped by 7.4 percentage points to 39.8%. Gwangju and Jeolla Province decreased by 1.8 percentage points to 74.8%. By ideological inclination, moderates fell by 4.9 percentage points to 47.5%, and progressives dropped by 3.2 percentage points to 80.4%. (권역별로는 대구·경북이 전주 대비 9.9%포인트 하락하며 34.6%로 나타났다. 인천·경기도 7.6%포인트 하락한 44.8%, 서울도 7.4%포인트 하락한 39.8%로 각각 조사됐다. 광주·전라는 1.8%포인트 하락한 74.8%였다. 이념성향별로는 중도층에서 4.9%포인트 하락한 47.5%, 진보층에선 3.2%포인트 하락한 80.4%로 각각 나타났다.)

Realmeter analyzed, "The spread of responsibility triggered by the poor election management and the conflict over party leadership within the ruling party acted as negative factors for the overall political landscape. Despite some positive factors such as the achievements of the European tour and the KOSPI surpassing the 9,000 mark, concerns over asset market polarization were highlighted, leading to support erosion centered on moderates and the Seoul metropolitan area, continuing the downward trend." (리얼미터는 “선거관리 부실 사태로 촉발된 책임론 확산과 여당 내 당권 갈등이 정국 전반의 부정적 요인으로 작용했다”며 “유럽 순방 성과와 코스피 9000선 돌파 등 일부 긍정 요인에도 불구하고, 자산시장 양극화 우려가 부각되며 중도층과 수도권을 중심으로 지지 이탈이 나타나 하락세가 이어진 것으로 보인다”고 분석했다.)

The presidential office issued a statement on the same day, saying, "The recent fluctuations in approval ratings appear to reflect a comprehensive assessment of the public's perception of the livelihood economy situation and the overall state of governance." President Lee also said in a press conference on the 19th, "The approval rating has been plummeting since the election day, and we must take it seriously. There may be various analyses, but I think the biggest sentiment is, 'We're struggling to make a living, and you're fighting over what?'" This was interpreted as a remark keeping in mind the intensifying conflict within the Democratic Party of Korea ahead of the national convention in August. For more details, refer to the Central Election Opinion Survey Deliberation Committee website. (청와대는 이날 입장을 내어 “최근 지지율 변동은 민생경제 상황에 대한 국민의 체감과 국정운영 전반에 대한 평가가 종합적으로 반영된 결과로 보인다”고 말했다. 이 대통령도 지난 19일 기자회견에서 “선거일을 기점으로 지지율이 폭락하고 있는데, 엄중하게 받아들여야 한다”며 “여러 가지 분석이 있겠지만, 먹고살기 힘들어 죽겠는데, 뭘 가지고 싸우는 거야 라는 생각이 제일 클 것”이라고 말했다. 이는 오는 8월 전당대회를 앞두고 격화되는 더불어민주당 내 갈등을 염두에 둔 발언으로 해석됐다. 자세한 내용은 중앙여론조사심의위원회 누리집을 참고하면 된다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Senior Official Expects Nuclear Submarine and Uranium Enrichment Negotiations with the US to be Concluded This Year (고위 당국자 “올해 안 한미 핵잠·우라늄 농축 협상 타결 기대”)
item.description:
Foreign Minister Cho Hyun stated on the 22nd that the government has proactively prepared by forming an economic cooperation task force (TF) to enable South Korean companies to participate in reconstruction projects in the Middle East following a potential US-Iran agreement on ending the war. A senior official from the Foreign Ministry, which has initiated discussions with the US on uranium enrichment, spent nuclear fuel reprocessing, and nuclear-powered submarines, expressed hopes for a resolution within the year. (조현 외교부 장관은 22일 정부가 미국과 이란의 종전 합의 이후 한국 기업이 중동 지역 재건 사업에 참여할 수 있도록 경제협력팀(TF)을 구성해 선제적으로 준비해왔다고 밝혔다. 미국과 우라늄 농축·사용후 연료 재처리, 핵추진잠수함(핵잠) 협의를 게시한 외교부는 올해 안에 협상 타결을 기대하고 있다고 고위 당국자가 밝혔다.)

Minister Cho said at a press briefing held at the Foreign Ministry building that day, “The Foreign Ministry has been proactively preparing for post-war scenarios even before the possibility of a US-Iran memorandum of understanding (MOU) to end the war was raised.” He added, “To facilitate our companies’ participation in post-war recovery in the Middle East and to develop comprehensive and holistic economic cooperation measures with the region, we have established a ‘Korea-Middle East Comprehensive Economic Cooperation Team (TF)’ within the ministry. Through our overseas missions, we have actively identified tailored cooperation needs with countries in the Middle East.” However, the TF is primarily focused on cooperation with Gulf states, and participation in Iran’s reconstruction projects will be concretized while monitoring progress in US-Iran negotiations. (조 장관은 이날 외교부 청사에서 열린 기자간담회에서 “외교부는 미·이란간 종전 양해각서(MOU) 타결 가능성이 제기되기 이전부터 종전 이후를 선제적으로 대비해 왔다”며 “전후 우리 기업의 대중동 피해 복구 참여와 더불어 중동과의 포괄적이고 종합적인 경제협력 방안 마련을 위해 외교부 내 ‘한-중동 포괄적 경제 협력팀(TF)'을 설치했고, 재외공관을 통해 중동 각 국가들과의 맞춤형 협력 수요를 적극 발굴해왔다”고 말했다. 다만 이 티에프는 걸프국가들과의 협력을 우선 염두에 둔 것이고 이란 재건 사업 참여 등은 미국-이란의 협상 진전을 보면서 구체화한다는 방침이다.)

Minister Cho noted, “This morning, two of our ships passed through the Strait of Hormuz, leaving a total of 22 vessels remaining in the strait.” He continued, “We are continuously monitoring navigation conditions in the Strait of Hormuz and the safety of our ships and crew. We are also maintaining ongoing cooperation with relevant countries to ensure the prompt, free, and safe navigation of all vessels, including ours.” He added that a phone call with Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi is being coordinated soon to discuss this issue. (조 장관은 “오늘 오전 우리 선박 2척이 호르무즈해협을 통과함에 따라 해협 내 총 22척이 잔류하고 있는 상황”이라고 밝혔다. 조 장관은 “호르무즈해협 통항 여건과 우리 선박, 선원의 안전을 지속적으로 점검해 나가면서 우리를 포함한 모든 선박의 자유롭고 안전한 항행이 조속히 이뤄지도록 유관국과 협력을 지속해 나가고 있다”면서 이 문제를 협의하기 위해 아바스 아라그치 이란 외무장관과의 통화가 곧 이뤄지도록 조율하고 있다고 밝혔다.)

Meanwhile, regarding the ROK-US nuclear cooperation and nuclear submarine consultations, a senior Foreign Ministry official stated, “The last consultations were held in South Korea, and another round will take place in the US soon.” He added, “The leaders of both countries have already agreed to swiftly conclude these consultations, and we expect all of this to be resolved within the year.” From the 2nd to the 3rd, ROK and US officials met in Seoul to discuss implementation of security cooperation agreed upon by the two leaders in October of last year, including securing South Korea’s rights to uranium enrichment and spent nuclear fuel reprocessing, as well as the construction of nuclear-powered submarines. (한편 이날 외교부 고위 당국자는 한미 원자력 협력·핵잠 협의와 관련해 “지난번에 협의가 한국에서 있었고, 머지 않아 미국에서도 있을 것”이라며 “양국 정상은 신속하게 협의를 마치기로 이미 합의했고, 연내에 이런 모든 것이 타결될 수 있을 것으로 기대한다”고 밝혔다. 한미 양국은 지난 2∼3일 서울에서 한국의 우라늄 농축· 사용후 핵연료 재처리 권한 확보, 핵잠 건조 등 한미 정상이 작년 10월에 합의한 안보 분야 협력이행 문제를 논의했다.)

For South Korea to obtain enrichment and reprocessing rights, the existing ROK-US Atomic Energy Agreement must be amended. Options being discussed include a full revision, partial revision, or securing rights through an addendum. The senior official said, “There could be an amendment to the nuclear cooperation agreement, or we could utilize existing provisions and attach an addendum—there are various methods. We will decide based on the content of the agreement.” (한국이 농축·재처리 권한을 가지려면 기존 한미 원자력협력협정을 개정해야 하는 데 협정 전면 개정, 부분 개정, 약정을 통한 권한 확보 등의 방안이 거론된다. 고위 당국자는 “원자력 협력 협정의 개정이 있을 수 있고 거기에 기존에 있는 것을 활용해서 부록(addendum)을 붙이는 방안도 있고 여러 가지가 있다”며 “합의하는 내용을 봐가면서 결정하려고 한다”고 말했다.)

President Lee Jae-myung recently proposed “phased denuclearization” to US President Donald Trump at a dinner during the G7 summit, raising interest in resuming North Korea-US talks. However, some point to subtle differences in the positions of South Korea and the US. In response, the senior official said, “We have continued working-level negotiations and coordination with the US, so there are no major differences in our positions fundamentally.” He added, “Regarding North Korea sanctions, it’s not an immediate situation to lift them. We will begin dialogue and agree on the goal of achieving a freeze, reduction, and then complete denuclearization.” This countered the criticism that phased denuclearization, which focuses on freezing North Korea’s nuclear capabilities as a starting point, could essentially be a nuclear disarmament negotiation that tacitly recognizes North Korea’s nuclear status—differing from the Trump administration’s officially stated policy of “complete denuclearization.” (이재명 대통령이 최근 주요 7개국(G7) 정상회의 만찬에서 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령에게 ‘단계적 비핵화'를 제안하면서 북미 협상 재개에 대한 관심이 높아졌지만, 한미간에 미묘한 입장차가 있는 것 아니냐는 지적도 나오고 있다. 이에 대해 이 고위 당국자는 “저희가 미국과 실무적 협상과 조율을 계속해왔기 때문에 (양국 입장에는) 기본적으로 큰 차이는 없다”면서, “대북 제재 문제도 당장 제재부터 풀어야할 상황은 아니고, 대화를 시작해 중단-감축-완전한 비핵화를 이뤄나간다는 목표에 합의해 나갈 것”이라고 말했다. 북한의 핵 능력 동결을 시작점으로 삼으려는 단계적 비핵화는 북한의 핵 보유를 어느 정도 인정하는 사실상의 핵군축 협상일 수 있다는 점에서 트럼프 행정부가 공식적으로 밝혀온 ‘완전한 비핵화' 기조와 다를 수 있다는 지적을 반박한 것이다.)

Regarding the recent summit between Chinese President Xi Jinping and North Korean Chairman Kim Jong-un, where references to denuclearization were omitted—fueling speculation that China is condoning North Korea’s nuclear program—the senior official assessed, “China’s avoidance of discussing North Korea’s nuclear issues or denuclearization stems from a complex interplay of its relations with North Korea, as well as Russia’s ties with North Korea.” He added, “If the North Korea-China-Russia alignment deepens further, that would certainly be unwelcome for us. We are making diplomatic efforts to prevent this trend from intensifying.” On the continued postponement of Chinese Communist Party Foreign Affairs Commission Director and Foreign Minister Wang Yi’s visit to South Korea, the official said, “I understand the visit will take place soon,” adding, “We will discuss ways to further smooth and elevate South Korea-China relations.” (최근 시진핑 주석의 방북과 김정은 북한 국무위원장과의 정상회담에서 비핵화 언급이 사라지고 중국의 북핵 묵인설이 확산하는 데 대해 고위 당국자는 “중국이 북핵, 비핵화에 대한 언급을 회피하는 것은 잘 아시다시피 중국과 북한과의 관계, 또 러시아와 북한 간의 관계 이런 것들과 종합적으로 작용하고 있다”고 평가했다. 이어 “혹시라도 북·중·러 진영화가 깊어진다면 분명히 우리로서는 달갑지 않은 일”이라며 “이런 현상이 심화하지 않도록 외교적 노력을 해나가고 있다”고 덧붙였다. 왕이 중국공산당 중앙외사판공실 주임 및 외교부장의 방한이 계속 미뤄지는 상황에 대해서는 “(방한이) 머지않아 있을 것으로 알고 있다”면서 “한중관계를 더 원활하게 하고 격상시킬 방안을 협의해보겠다”고 밝혔다.)

Regarding Unification Minister Chung Dong-young’s suggestion at the “2026 International Korea Forum” that day about the possibility of a personal letter exchange between North Korea and the US, the senior official described it as “a hopeful statement from the Ministry of Unification.” On the restrictions on intelligence sharing between South Korea and the US triggered by Minister Chung’s remarks about “North Korea’s constituent nuclear facilities,” he said, “Both the US side and we are looking for an exit on this issue. I believe it will happen as such.” This suggests that the issue has not been fully resolved between South Korea and the US yet. (이 고위 당국자는 정동영 통일부 장관이 이날 ‘2026 국제 한반도 포럼'에서 북미 정상 간 친서 외교 가능성을 제기한 것에 대해서는 “통일부의 희망적 이야기”라고 평가했다. 정동영 장관의 ‘북한 구성 핵시설' 발언이 촉발한 한미 간 정보 공유 제한에 대해서는 “미국 측도 그렇고 우리도 그렇고 여기에 대한 출구를 찾지 않겠는가. 그렇게 될 것으로 믿는다”고 밝혔다. 아직은 한미간에 이 문제가 완전히 해결되지는 않은 것으로 해석되는 대목이다.)

Regarding the Agreement on the Acquisition and Cross-Servicing Agreement (ACSA) with Japan, which Japan has actively requested, the senior official stated, “Given the difficult international situation, it seems the time has come to consider such agreements. However, we need more time to review whether domestically we are ready to accept it.” (일본이 적극적으로 요구하고 있는 한일군수지원협정(ACSA·악사)에 대해 이 고위당국자는 “국제 정세가 어렵기 때문에 이러한 협정을 이제 검토해야 될 시기가 온 것 같다”면서 “다만 국내적으로 이게 수용할 준비가 되어 있는가 우리가 좀 더 시간을 갖고 검토를 해야 될 것”이라고 말했다.)

Park Min-hee, Senior Reporter minggu@hani.co.kr (박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Boo-kyum: "I Will Thoughtfully Explore Daegu's Path Forward with Its Citizens" (김부겸 “대구가 나아갈 길, 시민들과 함께 고민하겠다”)
item.description:
Former Prime Minister Kim Boo-kyum, who ran as the Democratic Party of Korea's candidate for mayor of Daegu in the June 3 local elections but was narrowly defeated, stated on the 22nd, "Daegu is in a difficult situation right now. The hope of Daegu lies in its citizens. I will thoughtfully deliberate with you all on the path Daegu should take." (6·3 지방선거에서 더불어민주당 대구시장 후보로 출마했다가 석패한 김부겸 전 국무총리가 22일 “지금 대구가 쉽지 않다. 대구의 희망은 시민 여러분”이라며 “대구가 나아갈 길에 대해 여러분과 함께 차분히 고민해 나가겠다”고 밝혔다.)

In a thank-you text message sent to citizens, the former Prime Minister wrote, "After the election ended, I did nothing but rest. As I gradually regained my strength, I did a lot of thinking." (김 전 총리는 이날 시민들에게 보낸 감사 인사 문자메시지에 “선거가 끝나고 아무것도 안 한 채 쉬기만 했다. 조금씩 기력을 회복하면서 많은 생각을 했다”며 이렇게 적었다.)

Kim added, "The first thing that came to mind was the faces of the countless citizens who encouraged me. From your smiling expressions as you looked at me, your warm gazes, the hands that firmly grasped mine, and the arms that embraced my back, energy was transmitted to me. Without that energy, how could I, at my age, have managed a grueling two-month campaign from dawn until late at night? Thank you. And I am sorry." (김 전 총리는 “가장 먼저 떠오른 건 격려해 주셨던 수많은 시민 여러분의 얼굴이다. 저를 바라보던 미소 띤 표정, 따뜻한 시선, 꼭 잡아주던 손, 등을 감싸 안아 주던 팔에서 제게로 기(氣)가 전달됐다”며 “그 기가 없었다면 어떻게 이 나이에 두 달을 새벽부터 밤늦도록 강행군할 수 있었겠느냐. 고맙다. 그리고 죄송하다”고 했다.)

He continued, "I know how much you must have agonized over casting your vote for me this time. The number 586,927 is not simply the votes I received. Each and every one of those votes contains a person's decision. It contains the life they have lived and the life they will live. I know that all too well." (그는 이어 “이번에 제게 표를 주시면서 여러분이 얼마나 많이 고민하셨을지 제가 안다”며 “58만6927이란 숫자는 단순히 제가 받은 표수가 아니다. 그 한 표 한 표에 한 사람 한 사람의 결단이 담겨 있다. 살아온 삶과 살아갈 인생이 담겨 있다. 그걸 제가 너무나 잘 안다”고 덧붙였다.)

Lee Kwang-jae, a Democratic Party lawmaker (four-term, Hanam-gap, Gyeonggi) who won the June 3 by-election for the National Assembly, wrote on Facebook the same day, "We must not forget former Prime Minister Kim Boo-kyum's tearful speech. We must treat comrades who have continued their lonely struggle, guarding the party in tough regions like Yeongnam, with the highest respect and give them opportunities. The Democratic Party must become a party that clearly appoints those who have dedicated and sacrificed themselves for the party." (6·3 국회의원 보궐선거에서 당선된 이광재 민주당 의원(4선·경기 하남갑)은 이날 페이스북에 “김부겸 선배의 눈물의 연설을 잊어서는 안 된다”며 “영남 등 험지에서 당을 지키며 외로운 싸움을 이어온 동지들을 최고의 수준으로 예우하고, 기회를 줘야 한다. 당을 위해 헌신하고 희생한 이들을 확실하게 중용하는 민주당이 돼야 한다”고 적었다.)

The Democratic Party's 'June 3 Local and By-election Evaluation Committee,' launched on this day, stated, "We performed well in many competitive regions that were considered conservative. We will evaluate the factors behind this victory, especially the strong support for candidate Kim Boo-kyum among voters in their 20s and 30s in the Daegu area, and include this in a white paper" (Rep. Lee Yeon-hee). (이날 출범한 민주당 ‘6·3 지방선거 및 재보궐선거 평가위원회’는 “보수적이라고 평가받던 접전 지역에서 많은 선전을 했는데 승리 요인이 뭔지, 특히 대구 지역 20·30대 유권자들이 김부겸 후보에 대해 높은 지지를 보냈던 점들을 평가해 백서에 담을 것”(이연희 의원)이라고 밝혔다.)

item.title: Ukrainian Foreign Minister to Visit South Korea on the 30th… Foreign Ministry “Pursuing Transfer of Captured North Korean Soldiers to South Korea” (우크라 외교장관 30일 방한…외교부 “북한군 포로 한국행 추진”)
item.description:
Andrii Sybiha, Ukraine’s Minister of Foreign Affairs, is scheduled to visit South Korea on the 30th and hold talks with Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul. This is expected to provide an opportunity to discuss the repatriation of two captured North Korean soldiers, who were deployed to Russia and are currently detained in Ukraine. (안드리 시비하 우크라이나 외교부 장관이 오는 30일 방한해 조현 외교부 장관과 회담할 예정이다. 이를 계기로 러시아에 파병됐다가 우크라이나에 구금되어 있는 북한군 포로 2명의 송환 문제도 논의될 전망이다.)

Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul stated at a press briefing held at the Seoul Foreign Ministry building on the 22nd, “We plan to hold a meeting with Minister Sybiha on the 30th.” (조현 외교부 장관은 22일 서울 외교부 청사에서 기자간담회를 하면서 “오는 30일 시비하 장관과 회담할 예정”이라고 밝혔다.)

Regarding this, a senior Foreign Ministry official explained, “We have already reached a basic agreement with the Ukrainian side concerning the two captured North Korean soldiers.” He added, “We have repeatedly explained this, and the principle remains unchanged.” This reiterated the stance that the issue of prisoners of war must be resolved in accordance with the international law principle prohibiting the forced repatriation of POWs. (이와 관련해 외교부 고위 당국자는 “북한군 포로 2명에 대해선 우크라이나 측과 이미 기본 합의가 이뤄졌다”며 “여러 번 설명했고 그 원칙은 변함없다”고 설명했다. 국제법상 전쟁포로의 강제송환 금지 원칙에 따라 포로 문제가 해결돼야 한다는 입장을 다시 강조한 것이다.)

The senior official noted, “We are seeking to facilitate their transfer to South Korea as quickly as possible, based on their free will,” but when asked whether their transfer to South Korea would be announced during the Korea-Ukraine foreign ministerial meeting, he only said, “It’s difficult to say that, but we are working on it.” (이 고위 당국자는 “가급적 신속하게 자유 의사에 따라서 한국행을 추진하려고 하고 있다”면서도 이번 한-우크라이나 외교장관 회담 계기에 이들의 한국행이 발표되냐는 질문엔 “그렇게 얘기하기 곤란하고, 노력하고 있다”고만 말했다.)

Another Foreign Ministry official, meeting with reporters later that afternoon, explained, “We have conveyed our basic stance and international legal principles regarding the captured North Korean soldiers to Ukraine multiple times, and Ukraine fundamentally sympathizes with this.” However, he added, “As this involves a third party, it is appropriate to proceed discreetly.” This is interpreted to mean that bringing the captured North Korean soldiers to South Korea faces opposition from North Korea and Russia, and even if the issue of their transfer to South Korea is discussed during this meeting and the two soldiers are brought into the country, it will only be made public after all repatriation procedures are fully completed. (이날 오후 기자들과 만난 또 다른 외교부 당국자는 “북한군 포로와 관련한 기본 입장과 국제법적 원칙을 여러 차례 우크라이나에 전달했고, 우크라이나도 기본적으로 공감하고 있다”면서도 “다만 3자가 관련된 사안이라 은밀히 진행되는 것이 맞다”고 설명했다. 북한군 포로를 한국으로 데려오는 데에는 북한과 러시아의 반대가 있고, 이번 회담에서 북한군 포로 2명의 한국행 관련된 사안이 논의되고 이들이 국내로 들어오게 되더라도 송환 절차가 모두 완료된 후에야 공개될 것이라는 뜻으로 해석된다.)

item.title: Election Commission Finalizes 690 Election Challenges for June 3 Local Elections (선관위, 6·3 지방선거 소청 690건 최종 집계)
item.description:
Following the June 3 local elections, a total of 690 election challenges nationwide have been finalized as received by the National Election Commission and city/provincial election commissions. (6·3 지방선거 뒤 중앙선거관리위원회와 시·도선관위에 접수된 선거소청이 전국 690건으로 최종 집계됐다.)

According to the final status of challenge submissions to the National Election Commission on the 22nd, a total of 690 challenges were filed: 275 with the National Election Commission and 415 with city/provincial election commissions. Of the 275 received by the National Election Commission, 127 concern city/provincial governors, 67 concern superintendents of education, 60 concern proportional representation city/provincial councilors, 6 concern Sejong City councilors, and 15 are unspecified election challenges. There are 30 challenges related to the Seoul mayoral election, where disruptions occurred in voting and counting due to a shortage of ballot papers. Of the 415 challenges filed with city/provincial election commissions, 122 concern district/county/city heads, 110 concern district-level district/county/city councilors, 109 concern district-level city/provincial councilors, 64 concern proportional representation district/county/city councilors, and 10 are unspecified election challenges. Those classified as 'unspecified election challenges' may be reclassified depending on the future filing correction process. (22일 중앙선관위 소청 접수 최종 현황에 따르면 중앙선관위에는 총 275건, 시·도선관위에는 415건으로 총 690건의 소청이 제기됐다. 중앙선관위 접수분 275건은 시·도지사 127건, 교육감 67건, 비례대표 시·도의원 60건, 세종시의원 6건, 선거 불특정 15건이다. 투표용지 부족 사태로 인해 투표와 개표에 차질이 빚어진 서울시장 선거 관련 소청은 30건이다. 시·도선관위 접수분 415건은 구·시·군의 장 122건, 지역구 구·시·군의원 110건, 지역구 시·도의원 109건, 비례대표 구·시·군의원 64건, 선거 불특정 10건이다. ‘선거 불특정’으로 분류된 건은 향후 소청 서류 보정 절차 등에 따라 분류가 달라질 수 있다.)

An election challenge is a procedure for disputing the validity of an election, contesting the legality or fairness of the election results or process. Voters, candidates, and political parties that nominated candidates may file a challenge with the relevant election commission within two weeks of the election date. Challenges for city/provincial governor elections are filed with the National Election Commission, while those for basic local government heads and local councilors are filed with city/provincial election commissions. The People Power Party has also filed election challenges in seven cities and provinces, including Seoul, Gyeonggi, and Incheon. (선거소청은 선거 결과나 선거 과정의 위법·부당함에 불복해 선거 효력에 이의를 제기하는 절차다. 선거인(유권자), 후보자, 후보자를 추천한 정당이 선거일로부터 2주 이내 관할 선관위에 제기할 수 있다. 시·도지사 선거는 중앙선관위, 기초단체장·지방의원 선거는 시·도선관위에 소청한다. 국민의힘도 서울·경기·인천 등 7개 시도에 대해 선거소청을 제기한 바 있다.)

Once a challenge is received, the election commission's Challenge Review Committee is to make a decision within 60 days. If the commission upholds the challenge, a re-election is to be held within 30 days from the date the decision is notified. If the challenge is dismissed or rejected, the person who filed the challenge may raise an objection in court. (소청이 접수되면 선관위 소청심사위에서 60일 내 소청에 대한 결정을 내린다. 선관위가 소청을 받아들이면 결정 통지일로부터 30일 이내에 재선거를 실시하며, 기각·각하될 경우 소청을 낸 사람이 다시 법원에 이의를 제기할 수 있다.)

item.title: Democracy Party holds first meeting of June 3 election evaluation committee… "Will analyze support from Daegu's 20s and 30s, and Gangwon's strong performance" (민주, 6·3 선거평가위 첫 회의…“대구 2030 지지·강원 선전 분석할 것”)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea held the first meeting of its "June 3 Local Elections and National Assembly By-elections Results Evaluation Committee" on the 22nd. (더불어민주당이 22일 ‘6·3 지방선거 및 국회의원 재보궐선거 결과 평가위원회’ 첫 회의를 열었다.)

Lee Jae-young, head of the Democratic Research Institute and co-chair of the evaluation committee, said at a meeting at the National Assembly that day, "The starting point of the election evaluation is not self-blame but reflection." He added, "We will humbly summarize the achievements, honestly acknowledge the shortcomings, and turn the lessons into assets for the future." (평가위 공동위원장을 맡은 이재영 민주연구원장은 이날 국회에서 한 회의에서 “선거 평가의 출발점은 자책 아닌 성찰”이라며 “성과는 겸허히 정리하고 부족한 점은 솔직히 인정하며 교훈을 미래를 위한 자산으로 만들겠다”고 말했다.)

The evaluation committee consists of nine members. Lee and Hong Chang-min, former head of the Seoul City Party Public Official Candidate Recommendation Management Committee, serve as co-chairs. Other members include Bong Geon-woo, chairman of the Democratic Party's National University Student Committee; lawyer Chae Woo-ri, who served as a strategic nomination management committee member during this local election; Choi Jong-ho, CEO and political consultant of FM Winners; Professor Ji Byeong-geun from the Department of Political Science and Diplomacy at Chosun University; author Kim Nae-hoon, who wrote "The Radical Twenties"; and lawmakers Lee Yeon-hee and Baek Seung-ah. (평가위는 9명으로 구성됐다. 이 원장과 홍창민 전 서울시당 공직후보자추천관리위원장이 공동 위원장을 맡았고, 봉건우 민주당 전국대학생위원회 위원장, 이번 지방선거 때 전략공천관리위원으로 활동한 채우리 변호사, 최종호 에프엠위너스 대표 정치컨설턴트, 지병근 조선대 정치외교학과 교수, ‘급진의 20대’ 저자 김내훈 작가, 이연희·백승아 의원 등이 위원으로 참여했다.)

Lawmaker Lee Yeon-hee, who serves as the secretary, met with reporters after the meeting and outlined plans to examine the evaluation of the Seoul mayoral election, factors behind the strong performance in the Gangwon Province governor election, and the increased support among the 20s and 30s age groups evident in the Daegu mayoral election through meetings with campaign officials and elected officials. She said, "We will look at the entire country, but if there are regions that need special attention, we will meet with people regardless of whether they are from metropolitan or local areas, and listen to the factors behind victories in winning regions and defeats in losing regions." (간사를 맡은 이연희 의원은 회의 뒤 기자들과 만나 각 캠프 관계자·당선자 등과의 면담을 통해 서울시장 선거에 대한 평가, 강원도지사 선거에서의 선전 요인, 대구시장 선거에서 나타난 20·30 세대 지지세 증가 등을 살펴보겠다는 구상을 밝혔다. 그는 “전국을 다 보되 특별하게 들여다봐야 할 지역이 있다면 광역·기초를 가리지 않고 다 만나 승리 지역은 승리 요인, 패배 지역은 패배 요인을 다 들어보려고 한다”고 말했다.)

Lawmaker Lee emphasized that this election evaluation places a focus on "integration" and "expanding the base." She stated, "The election evaluation should not be a process of conflict to assign blame to someone, but a process of finding lessons for a better victory. What is needed is not a blame game but reflection, not division but integration, not exclusion but expansion." (이 의원은 이번 선거 평가가 ‘통합’과 ‘외연 확장’에 방점을 찍고 있다고 강조했다. 그는 “선거 평가는 누군가의 책임을 묻기 위한 갈등의 과정이 아니라 더 나은 승리를 위한 교훈을 찾는 과정이어야 한다”며 “필요한 것은 책임 공방이 아니라 성찰이고, 분열이 아니라 통합이며, 배제가 아니라 확장”이라고 했다.)

The evaluation committee will assess the nomination process and election results over 15 weeks until the end of September and publish a white paper summarizing its findings. Regarding the extension of the activity period from the initially planned eight weeks, Lawmaker Lee said, "Because there is a lot to evaluate." (이번 평가위는 오는 9월말까지 15주간 공천과정과 선거결과를 평가하고, 이를 정리한 백서를 낸다. 당초 8주로 계획했던 활동 기간을 늘린 데 대해 이 의원은 “평가할 게 많기 때문”이라고 말했다.)

item.title: Political circles call it "just retribution" as former Justice Minister Park Seong-jae sentenced to 25 years in prison for insurrection (내란 가담 박성재 ‘징역 25년’ 선고에 정치권 “인과응보”)
item.description:
As the court handed down a 25-year prison sentence in the first trial to former Minister of Justice Park Seong-jae, who was charged with participating in the insurrection, including inspecting detention facilities during the December 3 martial law, political circles responded that it was "just retribution." Rep. Kim Yong-min of the Democratic Party of Korea also stated, "The accountability of those who participated in the insurrection must be pursued to the end." (법원이 12·3 비상계엄 때 수용시설을 점검하는 등 내란에 가담한 혐의를 받는 박성재 전 법무부 장관에게 1심에서 징역 25년을 선고하자 “인과응보”라는 정치권 반응이 나왔다. 김용민 더불어민주당 의원은 “내란에 가담한 자들에 대한 책임 추궁은 끝까지 이어져야 한다”고도 했다.)

In a Facebook post on the 22nd, Rep. Kim said, "Although the special counsel had sought a 20-year prison sentence for the former Minister Park, the court handed down a 25-year sentence, exceeding that, and ordered his arrest in court. This is a result of the court strictly assessing the gravity of the act of participating in the insurrection." Noting that the court specified that the December 3 insurrection was a 'coup d'état of the guards' prepared since 2023, he also said, "It confirmed that the insurrection was not a deviation by some individuals but an organized crime that mobilized state power agencies." <<> Rep. Kim continued, "The responsibility of those who participated in the insurrection must be held to the end, regardless of their status or position. Democracy cannot exist without the liquidation of insurrection. This ruling is both a condemnation of the insurrection forces and an important milestone in the process of the Republic of Korea restoring its constitutional order." He added, "The pursuit of accountability for those who participated in the insurrection must continue to the end, and the principle that there are no exceptions before the law, regardless of one's status, must be firmly established." <<> On this day, the Criminal Settlement Division 33 of the Seoul Central District Court (Presiding Judge Lee Jin-gwan) sentenced former Minister Park to 25 years in prison. Former Minister Park had been on trial for charges including engaging in important duties of insurrection, for convening a Ministry of Justice meeting immediately after former President Yoon Suk Yeol's declaration of the December 3 emergency martial law and ordering follow-up measures for the martial law, thereby participating in the insurrection crime. The court stated, "The purpose of subverting the national constitution and awareness of illegality regarding (such acts) are recognized." Former Minister Park was arrested in court on the grounds that there was a risk of destroying evidence. <<> Son Sol, senior spokesperson for the Progressive Party, said in a commentary released on this day, "With this ruling, it has been revealed in broad daylight that the Minister of Justice, who should be the last bastion of the rule of law, was instead a key architect of the coup d'état of the guards." He added, "With the guilty verdict for former Minister Park, all key state council members of the insurrection regime have received actual prison sentences. This is a victory for the great people who defended the squares against the insurrection and for democracy." <<> Spokesperson Son evaluated, "This is the most shameless abuse of power and subversion of state affairs committed by one who should uphold the law and justice. It is just retribution. With this, it has been clearly established by history and the court that the Yoon Suk Yeol regime was an 'insurrection force' that sought to destroy the Republic of Korea. The judiciary today has clearly proven that the ultimate end of power that threatens the people using the law as a weapon is nothing but prison." <<> Regarding the court's dismissal of the charges of violating the Act on the Prohibition of Improper Solicitation and Graft related to First Lady Kim Keon Hee, on the grounds that it was "not subject to special counsel investigation," there was also a reaction of regret. Park Byeong-un, senior spokesperson for the Rebuilding Korea Party, said in a commentary released on this day, "In the series of trial proceedings, the courts have not been able to strictly handle cases related to Kim Keon Hee." He expressed concern, "If the judiciary of the Republic of Korea fails to properly and severely punish Kim Keon Hee, who was called 'V0' of Yongsan, there is a risk that the main body of the insurrection might escape." <<> Former Minister Park had been on trial on charges of receiving improper solicitations from First Lady Kim regarding the investigation, after a dedicated investigation team was formed at the Seoul Central District Prosecutors' Office in connection with the case of Kim receiving luxury handbags. He was allegedly asked by Kim about the progress of the investigation and later reported by the Ministry of Justice's head of Prosecution Division on the situation of the luxury handbag receipt. <<> Reporter Jeon Gwang-jun light@hani.co.kr (김 의원은 22일 페이스북을 통해 “특검이 (박 전 장관에게) 징역 20년을 구형했음에도 법원은 이를 상회하는 징역 25년을 선고하고 법정구속했다. 이는 내란 가담 행위의 중대성을 법원이 엄중하게 평가한 결과”라고 말했다. 재판부가 12·3 내란이 2023년부터 준비된 ‘친위 쿠데타’라고 명시한 점을 들어 “내란이 일부 인사의 일탈이 아니라 권력기관이 동원된 조직적 범죄였음을 확인한 것”이라고도 했다.)

item.title: President Lee's approval rating sees 'death cross' first time in 40% range…Concerns "state affairs momentum may wane" (이 대통령 지지율 ‘데드크로스’ 첫 40%대…“국정 동력 떨어질라” 우려)
item.description:
A poll released on the 22nd showed President Lee Jae-myung's approval rating for state affairs dropped to the 40% range for the first time since taking office, recording a 'death cross' where negative evaluations surpassed positive ones. The presidential office stated, "We accept this gravely and humbly, and will more carefully examine what the people are worried about and what they hope for." Experts view this as a combination of factors, including the National Election Commission's shortage of ballots and conflicts within the Democratic Party of Korea. (이재명 대통령의 국정 수행 지지율이 취임 뒤 처음으로 40%대로 떨어지고, 부정평가가 긍정평가를 앞서는 ‘데드크로스’를 기록했다는 여론조사 결과가 22일 나왔다. 청와대는 “이를 엄중하고 겸허하게 받아들이며 국민께서 무엇을 걱정하고 무엇을 바라고 계신지 더욱 세심하게 살피겠다”고 말했다. 전문가들은 중앙선거관리위원회의 투표용지 부족 사태와 더불어민주당 내 갈등 등이 복합적으로 작용한 것으로 보고 있다.)

According to a survey conducted by Realmeter on behalf of Energy Economy News from the 15th to the 19th, targeting 2,517 voters aged 18 and over nationwide using a wireless (100%) automated response method (with a sampling error of ±2 percentage points at a 95% confidence level), positive evaluations of President Lee's state affairs performance fell by 4.8 percentage points from the previous week to 46.7%. Negative evaluations rose by 5.5 percentage points to 49.7%. Those who responded "don't know" accounted for 3.6%. Although within the margin of error, negative evaluations surpassed positive ones, marking the first death cross since his inauguration, and it is also the first time the approval rating has fallen to the 40% range based on Realmeter surveys. (리얼미터가 에너지경제신문 의뢰로 지난 15∼19일 전국 18살 이상 유권자 2517명을 대상으로 실시한 무선(100%) 자동응답 방식의 조사(표본오차 95% 신뢰 수준에 ±2%포인트)를 보면, 이 대통령 국정 수행에 대한 긍정평가는 전주보다 4.8%포인트 하락한 46.7%를 기록했다. 부정평가는 전주 대비 5.5%포인트 상승한 49.7%로 나타났다. ‘잘 모름’은 3.6%로 조사됐다. 오차범위 내 결과이긴 하지만 부정평가가 긍정평가를 앞서며 취임 후 첫 데드크로스가 나타났고, 리얼미터 조사 기준 국정 수행 지지율이 40%대로 내려온 것도 처음이다.)

By region, the Daegu and North Gyeongsang area saw the largest drop, falling 9.9 percentage points from the previous week to 34.6%. Incheon and Gyeonggi Province (44.8%) fell by 7.6 percentage points, and Seoul (39.8%) dropped by 7.4 percentage points. By ideological inclination, the centrist group fell by 4.9 percentage points to 47.5%, while the progressive group dropped by 3.2 percentage points to 80.4%. (권역별로는 대구·경북 지역이 전주 대비 9.9%포인트 하락한 34.6%로 가장 큰 하락폭을 보였다. 인천·경기(44.8%)는 7.6%포인트, 서울(39.8%)은 7.4%포인트 떨어졌다. 이념성향별로는 중도층에서 4.9%포인트 하락한 47.5%, 진보층에선 3.2%포인트 하락한 80.4%로 각각 조사됐다.)

Realmeter and political scientists pointed to asset polarization, the party-presidential office conflict exposed ahead of the Democratic Party's national convention in August with signs of overheating, and the National Election Commission's ballot shortage as major causes for the decline. (리얼미터와 정치학자들은 자산 양극화와 8월 더불어민주당 전당대회를 앞두고 노출된 당-청 갈등과 과열 조짐, 중앙선거관리위원회 투표용지 부족 사태를 주요 하락 원인으로 꼽았다.)

Realmeter stated, "The spread of responsibility triggered by the election management failure and the ruling party's internal power struggles acted as negative factors across the political landscape. Despite some positive factors such as the achievements of the European tour and the KOSPI breaking the 9,000-point mark, concerns over asset market polarization came to the fore, leading to support erosion among centrists and in the Seoul metropolitan area, continuing the downward trend." (리얼미터는 “선거관리 부실 사태로 촉발된 책임론 확산과 여당 내 당권 갈등이 정국 전반의 부정적 요인으로 작용했다”며 “유럽 순방 성과와 코스피 9000선 돌파 등 일부 긍정 요인에도, 자산시장 양극화 우려가 부각되며 중도층과 수도권을 중심으로 지지 이탈이 나타나 하락세가 이어진 것으로 보인다”고 말했다.)

Professor Lee Jae-mook of the Department of Political Science and International Relations at Hankuk University of Foreign Studies said, "The recent 'Myung-Cheong conflict' ahead of the national convention likely played a role, and outside the party, the poor election issue emerged, causing even some conservatives to defect." Professor Lee Jun-han of the Department of Political Science and International Relations at Incheon National University also commented, "Typically, a president's approval rating rises after overseas trips, but this time, despite attending the G7 summit, the president appeared to intervene in internal party strife, leading to a drop in approval ratings." (이재묵 한국외대 정치외교학과 교수는 “최근 전당대회를 앞두고 ‘명청 갈등’도 이유가 됐을 것이고, 당 바깥으로는 부실선거 이슈가 나오면서 일부 보수층도 이탈한 것으로 보인다”고 말했다. 이준한 인천대 정치외교학과 교수도 “통상 대통령이 순방을 가면 지지율이 뛰었는데, 이번에는 주요 7개국(G7) 정상회의에 참석했음에도 오히려 대통령이 내부 정쟁에 개입하는 모습까지 보이면서 지지율이 떨어졌다”고 말했다.)

The party and the presidential office bowed their heads to the poll results. The presidential office issued a statement saying, "The recent fluctuation in approval ratings appears to reflect a comprehensive evaluation of the public's perception of the economic situation and overall state affairs management." Kang Jun-hyun, the senior spokesperson for the Democratic Party of Korea, told reporters after the supreme council meeting, "We feel a great sense of responsibility and will proceed with discussions within the party." (당청은 여론조사 결과에 고개를 숙였다. 청와대는 이날 입장을 내고 “최근 지지율 변동은 민생경제 상황에 대한 국민의 체감과 국정운영 전반에 대한 평가가 종합적으로 반영된 결과로 보인다”고 말했다. 강준현 더불어민주당 수석대변인은 이날 최고위원회 뒤 기자들과 만나 “많은 책임감을 느끼고 있으며 당내에서 논의 절차를 밟도록 하겠다”고 말했다.)

Within the ruling camp, there is a sense of concern that the momentum of state affairs could be lost. (여권 안에서는 국정동력이 상실될까봐 우려하는 분위기다.)

A presidential office official said, "There are aftereffects from the June 3 local elections, and the split in the support base ahead of the national convention has also had an impact. Since it could weaken the momentum of state affairs, this is not something to take lightly." A sense of crisis is also felt within the ruling party. A multi-term lawmaker from the Seoul metropolitan area said, "We should just accept the results as they are," but added, "With various schedules ahead, such as the confirmation hearing for Prime Minister nominee Han Sung-sook and the National Assembly's investigation into the Election Commission, we will have to monitor how long the decline continues." (청와대 관계자는 “6·3 지방선거 후유증도 있고, 전당대회를 앞두고 지지층이 갈라지는 것도 영향을 미쳤다”며 “국정동력이 떨어질 수 있기 때문에 가볍게 넘길 문제는 아니다”라고 말했다. 여당 내부에서도 위기감이 감지된다. 한 수도권 다선 의원은 “결과가 나온 그대로 보고 받아들여야 하지 않겠냐”면서도 “한성숙 국무총리 후보자 인사청문회나 선관위 국정조사 등 여러 일정들이 남아있으니 (하락세가 얼마나 지속될지는) 지켜봐야 할 것 같다”고 말했다.)

item.title: US Expert: "Trump-Kim Meeting Dangerous… Must Face Changed North Korean Reality" (미 전문가 “트럼프·김정은 만남 위험해…달라진 북한 현실 직면해야”)
item.description:
Joel Wit, a special researcher at the Stimson Center in the US who has experience in North Korean nuclear negotiations at the US State Department, expressed skepticism about the prospects for US-North Korea dialogue, emphasizing the need to recognize the changed reality of North Korea. (미국 국무부에서 북핵 협상을 한 경험이 있는 조엘 위트 미국 스팀슨 센터 특별연구원이 과거와 달라진 북한에 대한 현실을 봐야 한다며 북-미 대화 전망에 회의적 시각을 드러냈다.)

Participating virtually in the "2026 International Korea Forum" held at the Korea Federation of Banks in central Seoul on the 22nd, Researcher Wit stated, "Bringing together US President Donald Trump and North Korean Chairman Kim Jong-un is very dangerous," adding, "In (US-North Korea talks), Chairman Kim is very likely to agree to things we don't want." He also said, "(He is) highly likely to push a new North Korean agenda against South Korea, the US, and the international community." This reflects the reality that, with North Korea advancing its nuclear capabilities and sanctions effectiveness diminished due to closer North Korea-Russia ties, the likelihood of North and South Korean leaders meeting with North Korean denuclearization on the agenda has decreased. (22일 서울 중구 은행회관에서 열린 ‘2026 국제 한반도 포럼’에 화상으로 참여한 위트 연구원은 “도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령과 김정은 북한 국무위원장을 한자리에 모으는 것은 매우 위험한 일”이라며 “(북-미 회담에서) 김 위원장은 우리가 원하지 않는 일들에 동의할 가능성이 매우 높다”고 말했다. 그는 “남한과 미국, 국제사회를 상대로 북한의 새로운 의제를 밀어붙일 가능성이 높다”고도 했다. 북한이 핵 능력을 고도화하고, 북·러 밀착 등으로 제재의 효용성이 떨어진 상황에서, 북미 정상이 북한 비핵화를 의제로 만날 가능성은 낮아진 현실을 반영한 것이다.)

Researcher Wit noted, "It's also questionable whether the North would immediately be interested (in dialogue)," adding, "(In the past,) North Korea was serious about dialogue and engagement, but now that seriousness is not visible." He said, "The last 30 years of seeking change through engagement in North Korean nuclear negotiations are over," and stressed, "To develop relations with North Korea from a realistic perspective, we must understand not only history but also how different today's North Korea is from the past." (위트 연구원은 북측이 “(대화에) 당장 관심을 가질지도 회의적”이라며 “(과거) 북한은 대화와 관여에 진지했지만, 지금은 그러한 진지함이 보이지 않는다”고 말했다. 그는 북핵 협상 등에 관여하며 변화를 모색했던 “지난 30년의 시간은 끝났다”며 “현실적인 관점에서 북한과의 관계를 발전시켜 나가려면 역사뿐 아니라 오늘날 북한이 과거와 얼마나 다른지 이해해야 한다”고 말했다.)

Regarding the Lee Jae-myung administration's phased denuclearization plan, he stated, "Unless it aims to completely abandon the goal of denuclearization, it's not new." (이재명 정부의 단계적 비핵화 방안에 대해선 “비핵화라는 목표를 완전히 포기하려는 것이 아니라면 새롭지 않다”고 밝혔다.)

Comparing the first Trump administration, which led the US-North Korea summits from 2018 to 2019, with the current second administration, Researcher Wit said, "The situation we face today is very different (from the first term)." During the first term, then-Secretary of State Mike Pompeo and then-Special Representative for North Korea Policy Stephen Biegun provided a roadmap guiding Trump's policy toward North Korea, but now such resources are absent. Researcher Wit pointed out, "President Trump has become uncontrollable, and his diplomacy has failed in many areas," citing the US-Israel-Iran war as a "recent example of failure." (위트 연구원은 2018∼2019년 북-미 정상회담을 이끈 1기 트럼프 행정부와 현 2기 행정부를 비교하며 “(1기 때와) 우리가 오늘날 직면한 상황은 매우 다르다”고 했다. 1기 행정부 당시엔 마이크 폼페이오 당시 미 국무장관과 스티븐 비건 당시 대북정책특별대표 등이 트럼프 대통령과 대북 정책을 이끌며 로드맵을 제공했는데, 지금은 그러한 자원이 없다는 것이다. 위트 연구원은 “트럼프 대통령은 통제 불능에 빠졌고, 그의 외교는 여러 방면에서 실패했다”며 미·이스라엘-이란 전쟁이 “최근의 실패 사례”라고 지적했다.)

In response to criticism that this diagnosis might be overly pessimistic, he called for a sober assessment, saying, "It's not pessimism but a realistic perspective." (이러한 진단이 지나친 비관주의 아니냐는 지적에도 그는 “회의가 아닌 현실주의적 시각”이라며 냉철한 상황 판단을 주문했다.)

Nevertheless, Researcher Wit proposed that the US, China, Russia, and South Korea create a joint declaration similar to the 1973 US-Soviet Agreement on the Prevention of Nuclear War. This would involve making a statement that preventing nuclear war is desirable, a content level that North Korea might also agree to. (위트 연구원은 다만 미국과 중국, 러시아, 한국이 1973년 미국과 소련이 맺은 핵전쟁 방지 협정과 같은 공동선언문을 만들자고 제안했다. 핵전쟁을 방지하는 것이 바람직하다는 선언을 하자는 것으로, 이런 수준의 내용엔 북한도 동의할 가능성이 있다고 봤다.)

Researcher Wit participated as a US State Department official in the negotiating team for the 1994 US-North Korea Geneva Agreed Framework and oversaw the implementation of the agreement until he left the government in 2002. Since then, he has consistently researched the North Korean nuclear issue at foreign policy and security think tanks such as the Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS), the Johns Hopkins School of Advanced International Studies (SAIS), and the Stimson Center. He is also a co-founder of the North Korea-focused analysis media outlet 38North. item.title: Kang Hoon-sik: "Excess tax revenue from semiconductors should be intensively invested in projects for future generations" (강훈식 “반도체 초과세수, 미래세대 위한 사업에 집중 투자해야”)
item.description:
Presidential Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik stated on the 22nd that "excess tax revenue expected from the semiconductor boom should be intensively invested in projects for future generations." (강훈식 대통령비서실장이 22일 “반도체 호황으로 예상되는 초과 세수를 미래세대를 위한 사업에 집중 투자해야 한다”고 밝혔다.)

Deputy spokesperson Ahn Gwi-ryeong conveyed in a written briefing that Chief Kang made these remarks at a senior secretaries' meeting held at the presidential office, saying, "We must boldly invest in discovering new growth engines so that high-quality jobs can be expanded." Additionally, Chief Kang instructed that sufficient opportunities for direct participation from future generations should be guaranteed in the policy formation process. (강 실장은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 수석보좌관회의에서 “양질의 일자리가 확대될 수 있도록 신성장동력 발굴에도 과감히 투자해야 한다”고 밝혔다고 안귀령 부대변인이 서면브리핑을 통해 전했다. 아울러 강 실장은 정책 형성 과정에서 미래세대가 직접 참여할 수 있는 기회를 충분히 보장하도록 주문했다.)

Previously, President Lee Jae-myung also stated at a press conference marking his first anniversary in office on the 8th that "I believe excess tax revenue should be invested most intensively in directions that enhance South Korea's growth potential for future generations." (앞서 이재명 대통령도 지난 8일 취임 1주년 기자간담회에서 “초과 세수는 가장 중점적으로 미래 세대를 위한 대한민국 성장 잠재력을 키우는 방향에 투자해야겠다고 생각하고 있다”고 밝힌 바 있다.)

Furthermore, Chief Kang proposed broadly discussing fiscal reform tasks for future generations. Deputy spokesperson Ahn reported that Chief Kang emphasized, "If we fail to change the myriad accumulated problems due to concerns over social controversy, the burden on future generations will spiral out of control," and urged, "Let us find reasonable alternatives from the perspective of national interest and future generations, to ensure that the current generation and future generations share the burden of national administration fairly, and to secure investment resources for the future." (또 강 실장은 미래세대를 위한 재정개혁 과제들을 폭넓게 논의할 것을 제안했다. 강 실장은 “사회적 논란을 우려해 산적한 문제들을 바꿔 나가지 않는다면 미래세대의 부담이 걷잡을 수 없이 커질 것”이라며 “현세대와 미래세대가 국가 운영을 위한 부담을 공평히 분담하게 하고, 미래세대를 위한 투자재원을 확보할 수 있도록 국익과 미래세대의 관점에서 합리적 대안을 찾아나가자”고 강조했다고 안 부대변인은 전했다.)

Additionally, Chief Kang mentioned the case of a 20-year-old reservist who lost his life during training in Pocheon City, Gyeonggi Province a month ago, followed by an incident where 89 reservists at a training ground in Seocho-gu, Seoul exhibited vomiting symptoms after eating boxed lunches. He strongly reprimanded the relevant departments, asking, "How would young people feel about the country, the government, and the military?" Chief Kang stressed, "The place where young people stop their livelihoods and take time to devote themselves to the nation and community must not become a place full of distrust," and ordered the National Defense Secretary's office and related departments to reexamine not only food supply and hygiene but also the entire reservist training system from scratch. (이밖에도 강 실장은 한 달 전 경기도 포천시에서 20대 예비군이 훈련 중 목숨을 잃은 데 이어 최근 서울 서초구 예비군 훈련장에서 예비군 89명이 점심 도시락을 먹고 구토 증세를 보인 사안을 언급하며 “청년들에게 국가와 정부, 군이 도대체 어떻게 느껴지겠냐”며 관련 부서를 강하게 질책했다. 그러면서 강 실장은 “청년들이 국가와 공동체를 위해 생업을 멈추고 시간을 내어 헌신하러 가는 곳이 불신 가득한 곳이 되어서는 안 된다”며 국방비서관실과 관계부서가 급식과 위생뿐만 아니라, 예비군 훈련 체계 전반을 원점에서 다시 점검할 것을 지시했다.)

Regarding the recent arrest of three individuals, including a business owner, for abusive acts against workers at a salt field in South Jeolla Province, Chief Kang said, "Instances of labor exploitation and human rights violations, such as the 'salt field laborer human rights abuse' that occurred in Shinan County in 2014 and 2021, have recurred in 2026," calling it "heartbreaking and shameful." He instructed related ministries, including the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries, the Ministry of Employment and Labor, and the National Police Agency, to investigate whether there are similar cases and to develop effective measures to prevent recurrence. (또 강 실장은 최근 전남의 한 염전에서 노동자들을 상대로 가혹 행위를 한 업주 등 3명이 구속된 사안과 관련해 “2014년과 2021년 신안군에서 발생했던 ‘염전 노동자 인권침해’와 같은 노동 착취와 인권유린이 2026년에도 재발했다”며 “참담하고 부끄럽다”고 말했다. 이에 해양수산부, 고용노동부, 경찰청 등 관계부처에 유사 사례가 있는지 조사하고, 재발 방지를 위한 실효성 있는 대책 마련을 주문했다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: ‘Satisfied with election results’ 34%…“Both winners and losers feel uneasy” (‘지선 결과 만족’ 34%…“이긴쪽이나 진쪽이나 찜찜”)
item.description:
The June 3 local elections have been assessed as a so-called ‘uneasy election,’ with voter satisfaction with the results being very low. <<> Jung Han-wool, research designer and director of the Korea People Research Institute, presented as a speaker at the ‘June 3 Local Election Evaluation Emergency Symposium’ hosted by The Hankyoreh and the Alliance of Civil Society Organizations on the 22nd at the Korea Chamber of Commerce and Industry in Jung-gu, Seoul, delivering a presentation on ‘How to Read the June 3 Local Election Results: The Truth Behind the Numbers.’ <<> Director Jung presented survey results indicating that neither side is satisfied with the local election outcomes. <<> Director Jung stated, “The Democratic Party of Korea won 12 regional government headships, while the People Power Party won 4. Only 34% of respondents said they were satisfied with the election results, whereas 48% expressed dissatisfaction.” The satisfaction rate for Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon’s victory was 34%, while satisfaction with independent candidate Han Dong-hoon’s win in the Busan North Gap by-election for the National Assembly was 32%. Satisfaction with People Power Party candidate Yoo Eui-dong’s victory in the Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul by-election stood at 33%. Director Jung remarked, “This was an election where dissatisfaction outweighed satisfaction, leaving both winners and losers uneasy.” He added that when asked about ‘issues influencing their vote,’ voters most frequently cited ‘economic issues (such as KOSPI rises, exchange rates, and oil prices)’ and ‘the December 3 martial law and presidential impeachment issues.’ <<> Director Jung analyzed that in the June 3 local elections, “the narrative of judging the People Power Party may have been exaggerated.” <<> Director Jung said, “In the previous local elections, multiple opinion polls like Gallup Korea, which simplistically asked whether it was about ‘government stability or judgment,’ consistently showed ‘government stability’ in the lead, making it hard to question the interpretation that the ruling party held the advantage.” However, he noted that results from a secondary analysis model using computer-assisted web interviews (CAWI) conducted from the 12th to the 15th with 1,000 adults (men and women) were different. <<> The analysis revealed that the ‘one-sided opposition judgment theory’ stood at 48% in a survey right after the last presidential election but dropped significantly to 36% after these local elections, a decrease of 12 percentage points. The cynical and indifferent group, which was 12% in the post-presidential election survey, surged to 28% after these local elections, more than doubling. Regarding the results, Director Jung commented, “We confirmed that, unlike the last general and presidential elections, the one-sided conservative judgment theory was mitigated in these local elections.” The survey also showed that △ the ‘simultaneous judgment theory’ (judging both parties) was at 16%, and △ the ‘one-sided government judgment theory’ was at 20%. <<> Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (6·3 지방선거는 결과에 대한 유권자들의 만족도가 매우 떨어지는 이른바 ‘찜찜한 선거’였다는 평가가 나왔다.)

item.title: "Both Ruling and Opposition Parties Arrogant, Unable to Read Public Sentiment… Citizens Issue Warnings" (“여도 야도 민심 못읽고 오만…시민들 경고장 꺼내들었다”)
item.description:
“They were arrogant and failed to read the public sentiment.” (“민심을 읽지 못하고 오만했다.”)

Self-critical assessments have emerged regarding the results of the June 3 local elections, suggesting that both the ruling and opposition parties turned a blind eye to public sentiment and now face strong warnings from citizens. As politics failed to adequately embrace how our society must change following the ‘insurrection crisis,’ the Democratic Party of Korea did not secure an overwhelming victory, while the People Power Party narrowly avoided a crushing defeat by riding on the public’s desire to check the ruling party instead of pursuing self-renewal. <<> Democratic Party lawmaker Kim Young-bae, speaking as a panelist at the ‘Emergency Symposium on Local Election Assessment’ (hosted by The Hankyoreh and the Solidarity Conference of Civic Society Organizations) held on the 22nd at the Korea Chamber of Commerce and Industry's main conference hall in Jung-gu, Seoul, under the theme ‘Cracks and Questions in Korean Society Left by the June 3 Local Elections,’ assessed that “the Democratic Party conducted a visionless, strategy-less, and reckless election.” He stated, “We failed to present the party’s vision and policies, relying instead on the president’s high approval ratings,” adding, “I’ve never seen an election start with the confidence that the Democratic Party would win 15 out of 16 metropolitan mayoral races. There was no sense of tension or strategy.” He further noted, “Candidate nominations reflected the preferences of hardline party members rather than general election competitiveness, failing to attract centrist voters,” warning that “since our party holds all administrative and legislative power, if we do not renew our resolve, we will face even harsher repercussions in the next general and presidential elections.” <<> People Power Party lawmaker Park Jeong-ha, who also participated in the symposium’s panel discussion, pointed to the “closed leadership that ignored public sentiment” as a cause of the election results, stating that “the consolidation of forces defending the martial law and the leadership’s self-assured obsession led to these outcomes.” He highlighted significant issues with the party’s lack of self-awareness after the election. He criticized the leadership for “interpreting the Seoul mayoral election victory as a ‘glimmer of hope,’ straying from public sentiment, and exploiting the ballot shortage incident at the National Election Commission to incite claims of election fraud,” adding that “if the party cannot resolve the three issues—‘martial law, Yoon Suk-yeol, and internal party democratization’—it cannot become a governing party.” <<> There were also assessments that the ruling party was burdened by a lack of sophisticated approaches to real estate issues. <<> Choi Byung-cheon, a senior expert at the Jipyong Law Firm, attributed the ruling party’s losses in Seoul and parts of Gyeonggi Province, where high-priced apartments are concentrated, not to rising real estate prices but to the comprehensive real estate tax (CREFT) likely antagonizing apartment owners. Choi argued that the CREFT caused the ruling party’s defeat in apartment-dense areas along the Han River, describing it as a “Han River belt scorched-earth tax.” <<> Regarding real estate issues, Kim Young-bae stated that the government and ruling party should have persuaded the public by comprehensively considering housing stability and policy predictability, beyond merely curbing speculation and achieving tax justice. He ultimately diagnosed that “both homeowners and non-homeowners had grievances raised against them in this election.” <<> Criticism was also raised that the ‘political polarization’ concentrated on the two major parties has swept over central and regional politics, increasingly narrowing voters’ options. <<> Seo Bok-gyeong, director of the More Possible Research Institute, who presented at the symposium, expressed concern that “the number of candidates and parties running in local elections is shrinking, while uncontested elections (with no competing candidates) are increasing,” warning that “the roots of democracy are drying up.” She explained that in this local election, the average competition ratio for candidates in metropolitan and provincial councils (2.05 to 1) and city/county/district councils (1.66 to 1) was only ‘1.5 to 2 to 1,’ and the number of uncontested seats in city/county/district councils surged from 30 eight years ago to 311—a tenfold increase. She emphasized that “local democracy cannot function in a structure where voters have zero alternatives to choose from,” and highlighted the need for supplementary measures such as forming local parties active in neighborhoods and introducing a run-off voting system to institutionalize inter-party alliances. <<> Lee Ji-hyun, secretary-general of People’s Solidarity for Participatory Democracy (PSPD), also noted, “The proportional representation vote shares and actual vote percentages obtained by the major parties in local councils are disproportionately inflated compared to the seats they occupy,” adding that “votes supporting minor parties become wasted votes, distorting public sentiment.” <<> Amid this, there were calls to be cautious about hasty generalizations characterizing the young male generation as veering toward the far right. Shin Jin-wook, a sociology professor at Chung-Ang University, stated, “The political and social attitudes of the 20s and 30s generations have been highly fluid and volatile in recent years,” urging that “parties should not arbitrarily define this generation but must capture and respond to their specific grievances and demands.” Park Hye-min, CEO of Newways, also presented examples of initiatives to increase political participation among young people. <<> Kim Tae-il, former president of Jangan University, who moderated the panel discussion, assessed the public sentiment revealed through the local elections, saying, “The voices from the square (during the insurrection crisis) seem to have been exhausted before the system rather than being translated into institutional and political language, leading to a growing sense of loss.” He referenced former lawmaker Kim Boo-kyum’s failed bid as the Democratic Party’s candidate for Daegu mayor, stating, “Rather than beating down, excluding, and pushing aside opponents, the effort to persuade and embrace—like candidate Kim—might be the strength needed in politics.” <<> Song Ho-jin, senior correspondent at the Hankyoreh Economic and Social Research Institute, dmzsong@hani.co.kr ( 6·3 지방선거 결과를 두고 여야 모두 민심을 외면하다 시민들의 강한 경고 앞에 섰다는 자성적 평가가 나왔다. ‘내란 사태’ 이후 우리 사회가 어떻게 바뀌어야 하는지를 정치가 제대로 수용하지 못하면서 더불어민주당은 압도적 승리를 손에 쥐지 못했고, 국민의힘은 자기 쇄신 대신 여당에 대한 견제 심리에 올라타 겨우 궤멸적 패배를 모면했다는 것이다.)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae and Kim Min-seok Reaffirm "Abolition of Supplementary Investigation Rights" (정청래·김민석 “보완수사권 폐지” 재확인)
item.description:
Ahead of the August national convention to elect the next party leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, Jung Cheong-rae, a candidate for party leader, and Prime Minister Kim Min-seok both reaffirmed their stance on the "complete abolition of supplementary investigation rights" on the 22nd. (더불어민주당 차기 당대표를 뽑는 8월 전당대회를 앞두고 당권 경쟁이 예상되는 정청래 대표와 김민석 국무총리가 22일 나란히 ‘보완수사권 완전 폐지’ 입장을 재확인했다.)

During the Supreme Council meeting that day, Representative Jung stated, "Watching the trial of Lee Hwa-young (former Deputy Governor of Gyeonggi Province for Peace), I once again thought that the prosecution is a group that is truly difficult to reform," adding, "Not even a trace of supplementary investigation rights should remain." Earlier, on the 20th, the 11th Criminal Division of the Suwon District Court (Presiding Judge Song Byung-hoon) sentenced the former deputy governor to four months in prison for perjury (violation of the National Assembly Testimony and Appraisal Act) related to allegations of a "salmon drinking party." Representative Jung argued that the prosecution did not submit materials to the court, leading to the rejection of the former deputy governor's claim that "the prosecution improperly coaxed related individuals," and said, "If even a spoonful of supplementary investigation rights is given, they could turn that spoon into a sword and wield it against the administration at any time." <<> Prime Minister Kim also stated at a press briefing held at the Government Seoul Complex that day, "Based on the principle of separation of investigation and prosecution, I have always believed that abolishing supplementary investigation rights is correct." He added, "I understand President Lee Jae-myung has repeatedly expressed views on whether minimal exceptions might be necessary," but also noted, "Given significant public opinion that the prosecution cannot be trusted, if the discussion goes to the National Assembly and the conclusion is abolition, it seems he thinks it would be acceptable to proceed with that." President Lee had commented on the 19th, "If even very exceptional cases with no room for abuse are completely blocked, it could lead to problems later." <<> However, opinions differ on the timing of processing the Criminal Procedure Act, which includes provisions on granting supplementary investigation rights. Lawmaker Kim Yong-min, who is likely to run for party leader, called for a fast track on his YouTube broadcast that day, stating, "(Without waiting for negotiations on the formation of ruling and opposition party committees) The newly appointed chair of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee should lead the committee members to begin discussions from today. If an acceptable plan is formulated through our party, civil society, and the government, even before the national convention, it should be passed quickly." In contrast, lawmaker Song Young-gil said in an interview with MBC Radio, "This issue should be thoroughly deliberated with the new party leadership and resolved in the September National Assembly session." <<> Reporter Koh Han-sol: sol@hani.co.kr Reporter Jung Hye-min: jhm@hani.co.kr ( 정 대표는 이날 최고위원회의에서 “이화영 (전 경기도 평화부지사) 재판을 보며 검찰은 정말 고쳐 쓰기 어려운 집단이라고 다시 한번 생각했다”며 “보완수사권의 티끌마저 없어야 한다”고 말했다. 앞서 수원지법 형사11부(재판장 송병훈)는 지난 20일 이 전 부지사가 ‘연어 술파티’ 의혹을 제기해 위증한 혐의(국회증언감정법 위반)에 대해 징역 4개월을 선고했다. 정 대표는 검찰이 법원에 자료를 제출하지 않아 ‘검찰이 관련자들을 부적절하게 회유했다’는 이 전 지사 주장이 받아들여지지 않았다며 “숟가락만 한 보완수사권이라도 주면 그 숟가락으로 칼을 만들어서 정권에 언제 그 칼을 들이댈지 모를 일”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Supporters of Jung Cheong-rae and Kim Min-seok Engage in Heated 'Derogatory Name-Calling'…Senior Figures Warn: "What Remains If Division Grows?" (정청래·김민석 지지층 ‘멸칭 비방전’ 과열…중진들 “분열 키워 뭐가 남나”)
item.description:
With the August 17th party convention to elect a new leadership, including the Democratic Party of Korea's leader, approaching, internal competition is heating up, prompting a wave of concern among senior party lawmakers. In particular, there are growing criticisms that derogatory terms used mockingly to refer to individuals known to support potential convention candidates—such as Representative Jung Cheong-rae and Prime Minister Kim Min-seok—have crossed a dangerous line. (더불어민주당 당대표 등 새 지도부를 뽑는 8·17 전당대회를 앞두고 당내 경쟁이 과열 양상을 나타내자 당내 중진 의원들을 중심으로 우려의 목소리가 잇따르고 있다. 특히 전당대회 잠재적 주자인 정청래 대표와 김민석 국무총리를 지지하는 것으로 알려진 인사들을 묶어 조롱하듯 쓰고 있는 멸칭(경멸하는 명칭) 표현이 위험 수위를 넘어섰다는 지적이 나온다.)

Rep. Nam In-soon, a four-term lawmaker serving as the National Assembly's Deputy Speaker for the latter half of the 22nd term, wrote on Facebook on the 22nd, "Ahead of the convention, provocative derogatory names like 'Moon-Jo-Tteol-Rae-Yu' and 'Han-Gang-Sae-Ddong-Dwae-Ju-Gil' are spreading, targeting opposing factions and causing frowns. Derogatory terms are the enemy of democracy." She added, "Disparagement, mockery, and hatred weaken democracy and harm party unity. Instead of such terms, we need a forum for vision and policy, and instead of division and conflict, we need integration and progress." (22대 후반기 국회 부의장인 4선의 남인순 의원은 22일 페이스북에 “전당대회를 앞두고 ‘문조털래유’, ‘한강새똥돼주길’ 등과 같이 상대 진영을 비하하는 자극적인 멸칭이 확산해 눈살을 찌푸리게 하고 있다”며 “멸칭은 민주주의의 적”이라고 썼다. 남 부의장은 “비하와 조롱, 혐오는 민주주의를 병들게 하고 당의 단합을 해친다”며 “멸칭보다는 비전과 정책, 분열과 갈등보다는 통합과 전진의 장이 되어야 한다”고 했다.)

"Moon-Jo-Tteol-Rae-Yu" refers to former President Moon Jae-in, former People's Party leader Cho Kuk, broadcaster Kim Eo-joon, Rep. Jung Cheong-rae, and author Yoo Si-min. "Han-Gang-Sae-Ddong-Dwae-Ju-Gil" refers to lawmakers Han Jun-ho and Kang Deuk-gu, PM Kim Min-seok, YouTubers Lee Dong-hyung and Kim Yong-min, and lawmakers Lee Eon-ju and Song Young-gil. (문조털래유는 문재인 전 대통령, 조국 전 조국혁신당 대표, 김어준씨, 정 대표, 유시민 작가를 일컫는다. 한강새똥돼주길은 한준호·강득구 의원, 김 총리와 유튜버 이동형·김용민씨, 이언주·송영길 의원을 지칭하는 말이다.)

Four-term lawmaker Lee Kwang-jae expressed concern, saying, "We need to break the structure where candidates for party leader and supreme council members pair up to fight each other. Forming factions creates cliques and eventually shakes the very foundation of party democracy—the nomination process." Five-term lawmaker Park Ji-won said on YTN radio, "With four years of the remaining (presidential) term ahead, and no elections for the next two years, I'm deeply worried about why we're fighting like this and what we're even fighting over." Rep. Woo Won-shik, a five-term lawmaker and former National Assembly Speaker in the first half of the 22nd term, also wrote on Facebook the previous day, "If we go through the convention hurting each other, mocking each other, finding faults, and fueling division, what will be left for our party?" (4선 이광재 의원은 “당대표 후보와 최고위원 후보가 짝을 지어 싸우는 구조를 깨야 한다”며 “줄 세우기가 계파와 파벌을 만들고, 끝내 정당 민주주의의 근간인 공천까지 뒤흔들고 있다”고 우려했다. 5선 박지원 의원은 와이티엔(YTN) 라디오 방송에서 “나머지 (대통령) 임기 4년을 앞두고 더욱이 앞으로 2년간은 선거가 없는데 이렇게 싸워야 되는가, 뭘 가지고 싸우는가 굉장히 염려”하고 있다고 했다. 22대 국회 전반기 국회의장을 지낸 5선의 우원식 민주당 의원도 전날 페이스북에 “이렇게 서로에게 상처를 내고, 상대를 조롱하고, 흠집을 내고, 분열을 키우면서 전당대회를 치르고 나면 우리 당에는 무엇이 남는 것인가”라고 적었다.)

Amid this, Rep. Jung Cheong-rae and PM Kim Min-seok are reportedly close to announcing their candidacies for the convention. Despite some calls within the party for him not to run, Jung is expected to resign from his representative post around the 24th and formally declare his candidacy. Kim, during a press briefing at the Government Seoul Complex that day, repeatedly hinted at his candidacy, saying, "I feel an increasingly strong sense of responsibility to return to the party soon and do my utmost to strengthen the government's drive." (이런 가운데 정 대표와 김 총리의 전당대회 출마 선언은 임박한 것으로 관측된다. 정 대표는 당내 일각의 불출마 요구에도 오는 24일 전후로 대표직에서 사퇴하고 출마를 공식화할 거란 전망이 나온다. 김 총리는 이날 정부서울청사에서 한 기자간담회에서 “곧 당으로 돌아가면 국정 동력을 강화하는 데 전력을 다해야겠다는 책임감을 점점 더 강하게 느끼고 있다”며 출마를 거듭 시사했다.)
